description: Buy a dedicated monthly number in a country from search_dedicated_countries. Quote-then-commit: the tool fetches your live price and ties max_price_cents to it so you never pay above the quote. Returns a ded_xxx id - poll get_dedicated_number to read incoming SMS.

auto_renew.description: Auto-charge at the end of each monthly period

country.description: Country code or name from search_dedicated_countries (e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'germany')

name: purchase_dedicated_number
